name: Youth and Young Adult Services
city: Minneapolis, Saint Paul and Bloomington, MN
what_you_do: One on one career coaching, job and resume help, and help applying for partner employers' internships and jobs. Hired does not run internships itself. Also help with a diploma or GED, skills training and life skills.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 28 who live in Hennepin, Ramsey or Dakota County. You must meet low income (WIOA) rules. You must also have at least one more barrier. Examples are being a parent, not having stable housing, being 1 to 2 grade levels behind, or being at risk of dropping out. You can still ask if you are not sure.
pay_detail: The page does not state pay. It mentions subsidized internships, job shadows and work experience.
duration: About 6 months of programming, with up to 2 years of support
deadline_text: No deadlines. Staff follow up quickly after you send the referral form.
how_to_apply: Submit the youth and young adult referral form or the Inquire Now form on the Hired page. You must enroll to get services. Offices: Minneapolis 612-808-9500, Saint Paul 651-328-2777, Bloomington 952-303-8303.
notes: Funding sets what is offered. Help with school costs and living costs depends on what money is on hand.
